mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 6.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, causing a decline in corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE has exceeded 6.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 1.0% month-over-month signals a broad-based consumer spending collapse, which triggers a sharp decline in corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline by more than 1.0% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: During periods when industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, a sharp drop in manufacturing output signals an imminent recession, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annually signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 2.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1.5% signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate capital expenditure and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines by more than 1.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 6.0% and decline in employment (PAYEMS) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a severe labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0% and PAYEMS declines by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%), a further decline in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.
